title: Follow up on FP-2: 1 minor finding(s)?
body:
FP-2 shipped with 1 minor finding(s) still open:

- Diff against base branch (`/Users/naveensakhamuri/IdeaProjects/foreman-proof-node-1/.foreman/worktrees/w2/sum.mjs:85`): The local `main` ref is stale. It sits at f200415 and does not have FP-1, so `git diff main` also shows clamp() and its 7 tests as new. HEAD (story/fp-2) is 9d1e2fb, the same commit as origin/main with FP-1 merged. `git diff HEAD` shows only the clampAll export, the import change and the 7 clampAll tests. This story's change is in scope — fix: Fast-forward local main to origin/main (`git fetch && git branch -f main origin/main`) before the next review, or diff against origin/main

"Create a follow-up story" adds a story, "Follow-ups from FP-2", to fix them.
